finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NSIDC L102-L104 gives the ice-sheet flow pattern: slow near the shallow summit, outward to faster coastal outlet glaciers. Glossary L58-L64 identifies the internal divide. The options are related flow-map features but distinguish boundary, fast ribbon, coastal outlet, and grounded-to-floating transition.
finalGroupBindings.locator: NSIDC Ice Sheets L102-L105: ice flows outward from the center; near summit slow, faster toward coastal outlets; ice streams are fast ribbons bounded by slower ice; outlets carry ice to ocean and may become floating shelf. NSIDC Cryosphere Glossary L58-L64: ice divide separates opposing flow directions on a glacier or ice sheet. NASA Landsat L263: grounded ice detaches from seafloor and floats at the grounding line.
